name: Body Soul And Spirit
overview: Scripture reveals that man is a composite of body, soul, and spirit, each with distinct roles and eternal significance. God formed man from the dust and breathed life into him, making him a living soul (Genesis 2:7), while the spirit returns to God at death (Ecclesiastes 12:7). The soul is of great value, as Jesus warns against losing it even if one gains the whole world (Matthew 16:26), and it is something that can be destroyed in hell along with the body (Matthew 10:28). The soul also expresses worship and devotion, as seen in Mary's declaration of her soul magnifying the Lord (Luke 1:46).
